description: Return source-cited facts for agent payment protocols: spec URL, HTTP status codes and headers, payment rail, networks, facilitators, client libraries, pay flow, and an example. Every fact carries its source URL and verified_at; null means the cited page does not state it. Omit id and the output is the protocol-facts document whose protocols array has all ten protocols, unpaged. Pass id and the output is that one protocol object. There is no offset. Parameter id is optional and must be one of l402, bolt12, bip21, nwc, x402, mpp, ap2, acp, ucp, mcp. The mcp object has release_cadence and next_release_target from SEP-3398. Example: l402. An id outside the enum is rejected as invalid input. An enum id missing from the file returns isError with text No protocol with id <id>. A failed read returns isError whose text is the Error message. Use get_protocol_facts instead of search_sources when you need cited protocol facts rather than papers or docs. Use search_sources instead for those papers and docs. Use get_support_info instead for this site's donation addresses and paid API price. Use get_trust_checklist instead for this site's error codes and rate limits. Free, no auth.

id.description: Lowercase protocol id from the enum, e.g. l402. Set it to get one protocol object (smaller response); omit it to get every protocol in a protocols array.

name: get_protocol_facts
title: Get checked protocol facts
